vulnerabilities.title: SecondSwap Whitelist Contract Analysis
vulnerabilities.description: Smart contract security audit of SecondSwap_Whitelist.sol

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Access Control on Mint Function
vulnerabilities.description: The mint function lacks any access control mechanism, allowing any address to mint unlimited tokens. This violates the principle of least privilege and could lead to unauthorized token creation, causing severe economic damage.

vulnerabilities.title: Lack of Supply Cap
vulnerabilities.description: There is no maximum supply cap defined, allowing unlimited token minting. Combined with the missing access control, this creates a critical vulnerability where attackers can inflate the token supply at will.
